geometry.selection_rule: Frozen OOS false-accept nearest cluster with largest count; smallest cluster id breaks ties; display uses fixed Frozen score band [0.90,1.10]
geometry.projection_scope: separate local PCA per method; descriptive only

three_d.projection_scope: radial schematic: PCA direction and exact 384-D local normalized distance; sphere inclusion equals selected-center inclusion, not necessarily full Gate decision
three_d.coordinate_transform: u=(z-center)*sqrt(inv_diag_cov)/radius; each method has its own local coordinate system
three_d.display_transform: radial display clips normalized distances above 1.28 for readability while preserving inside/outside status and direction

selection_and_display_notes.local_geometry: Frozen OOS false-accept nearest cluster with largest count; smallest cluster id breaks ties; display uses fixed Frozen score band [0.90,1.10]
selection_and_display_notes.density_smoothing: fixed histogram bins followed by [1,2,3,2,1]/9 convolution
selection_and_display_notes.display_tail: values at or above the per-figure 99.5th-percentile cap are retained in the final bin/edge
selection_and_display_notes.sample_export: aggregate only; no raw embeddings, text, sample ids, or per-sample scores written
